reason: Migration acceptance, product build, and real Web E2E failed for the reviewed SHA. Missing/passing binary provenance cannot be claimed because make build failed.

failures.summary: Cross-version migration tests expect schema version 129 but the candidate migrates to 132.
make build fails during web TypeScript compile.
Playwright cannot spawn bin/agent-center because no binary was produced after build failure.

environment_notes: The initial web Vitest command failed because node_modules was absent; dependencies were installed with pnpm and the suite passed on rerun.
The E2E failure is not treated as a harness-only pass/fail ambiguity because the required product build failed first and no bin/agent-center existed.
